method: One cold claude -p CLI session (claude-haiku-4-5-20251001), resumed once per image with the identical analysis prompt used for the Sonnet run, against the SAME 15 PNGs in ../vision-sonnet/shots/. Per-image numbers are the CLI reported usage for that turn. Unlike the Sonnet session, no capture phase preceded analysis: the session starts cold, so the first turn carries the one-time system-prompt cache write and baseline cache_read is smaller throughout.
